news_title: CFS urges public not to consume batch of imported prepackaged cheese suspected to be contaminated with Shiga toxin-producing E. coli - www.info.gov.hk
efet_title: Food Alerts / Allergy Alerts - Not to consume batch of imported prepackaged cheese suspected to be contaminated with Shiga toxin-producing E. coli
efet_body:
Not to consume batch of imported prepackaged cheese suspected to be contaminated with Shiga toxin-producing E. coli
Issue Date
7.10.2026
Source of Information
Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed of the European Commission
Food Product
Prepackaged cheese
Product Name and Description
Product name: Camembert Bertrand Crémier 250g
Place of origin: France
Pack size: 250 grams
Use-by date: October 17, 2026
Batch number: 232511
Importer: Repertoire Culinaire Hong Kong Limited
Reason For Issuing Alert
The CFS received a notification from the Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed of the European Commission that the above-mentioned product is under recall due to possible contamination with Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC).
A preliminary investigation found that the above-mentioned importer had imported into Hong Kong the affected batch of the product concerned.
People can contract STEC-causing gastro-intestinal disease through consumption of contaminated water or undercooked and contaminated foods. Intestinal bleeding and serious complications such as hemolytic uraemic syndrome may also develop in some people.
Action Taken by the Centre for Food Safety
The importer has stopped sales, removed from shelves the affected batch of the product concerned and has initiated a recall according to the CFS's instructions.
The CFS has alerted the trade to the incident, and will continue to follow up and take appropriate action. The investigation is ongoing.
Advice to the Trade
Stop using or selling the affected batch of the product immediately.
Advice to Consumers
Stop consuming the affected batch of the product.
Further Information
The CFS press release
Members of the public may call importer's hotline at 3758 2754 during office hours with any enquiries about the recall.
Centre for Food Safety
Food and Environmental Hygiene Department

efet_title: Food Alerts / Allergy Alerts - CFS finds trace amount of formaldehyde in prepackaged rice vermicelli sample
efet_body:
CFS finds trace amount of formaldehyde in prepackaged rice vermicelli sample
Issue Date
29.8.2026
Source of Information
Food Surveillance Programme of the Centre for Food Safety (CFS)
Food Product
Prepackaged rice vermicelli
Product Name and Description
Product name: Hsin Tung Yang Rice Noodles
Brand: Hsin Tung Yang
Place of origin: Taiwan
Distributor: B&S Company
Net weight: 300 grams
Best-before date: April 10, 2029
Reason For Issuing Alert
The CFS collected the above-mentioned sample from an online vendor for testing under its Food Surveillance Programme. The test result showed that the sample contained formaldehyde at a level of 12 parts per million.
Action Taken by the Centre for Food Safety
The CFS has informed the vendor and the distributor concerned of the irregularity, and instructed the distributor concerned to immediately stop sales, remove from shelves, and initiate a recall of the affected batch of the product.
The CFS' follow-up investigation found that the distributor concerned stored about 450 cartons of the affected batch of the product in its warehouse. The CFS has immediately marked and sealed the products concerned.
The CFS has also enhanced formaldehyde testing at the import and retail levels, and has recently collected over 70 food samples, including Chinese white cabbages, vegetables and rice vermicelli, for testing of formaldehyde content. Except for the rice vermicelli sample detected with formaldehyde, no other unsatisfactory testing results have been found so far.
Advice to the Trade
Stop using or selling the affected batch of the product immediately if in possession.
Be cautious about the origins from which the food products are sourced, and should only obtain them from reliable sources.
Advice to Consumers
Not to consume the affected batch of the product concerned.
To patronise reliable restaurants and food retailers. As formaldehyde is water-soluble and highly volatile, washing and cooking food ingredients thoroughly before consumption can reduce the relevant risk.
Further Information
The CFS press release
Members of the public may call the distributor's hotline at 3628 7800 during office hours for enquiries about the recall.
Centre for Food Safety
Food and Environmental Hygiene Department
